references.purpose: course query by id or displayId, PricingPhaseEntity, ValuePropositionEntity
Read-only. Its CoverImage proposal and its fixture are carried over unchanged; its Tree, blocks and page are NOT, because they predate the host tag.

drift.planSaid: ContractHostTag exists and admits div, main, nav, ul, ol, form, section and aside
drift.nowTrue: The type is named ContractHost, matches the canon template exactly, and admits eleven members: div, ul, ol, li, form, nav, main, section, header, footer, aside.
drift.cause: Writing these entries found that the union admitted ul and ol but not li, so a list row could only be a div - a ul whose children are not li stops being announced as a list. li was merged into the canon template and then into the repository registry before this candidate was written.
drift.effect: Enlarges what the direction can express; nothing selected in Plan is invalidated. Recorded rather than treated as a stop, because the Plan direction was chosen ON the claim that regions would name themselves, and this is that claim being made available.

drift.planSaid: The sticky family in LayoutClassName remains first-child only, so a right-hand sticky rail still widens the union by five members
drift.nowTrue: Still true, and larger. Measured: the entries use 51 distinct classes, of which twelve are not union members - five sticky last-child members, two last-child grow members, three for the pinned bar, and pt-6 / pb-6.
drift.cause: Measured with a bracket-aware scan of the entries rather than by eye; an earlier regex count said three because it stopped at the ] inside md:[&>*:last-child]:sticky. pt-6 and pb-6 were added during revision 1.0 after the rendered mobile state showed the pinned bar lifting 24px off the bottom edge at the end of the scroll.
drift.effect: The proposal is twelve members, not five. Every one mirrors a member already present for the opposite child or the opposite edge.

runtime.note: Preview chrome frames the exported candidate through candidateUrl; it holds no HTML or CSS of its own.
